credential_policy: Credentials and real emails must never be committed. Runtime values belong in the approved test vault or manual QA record.

proofs: signup creates one teacher profile
session restores after browser restart
cannot read or mutate Teacher B private data
can create and manage own class
cannot use forged IDs to operate on Teacher A resources
cannot see Teacher A students or private progress
own data remains unchanged during Teacher A tests
signup creates one student profile
sees only active memberships and assignments
cannot promote own role
cannot mutate another student's progress
cannot enumerate memberships from another class
cannot open assignments with forged turma or assignment IDs
removal from class revokes access immediately
private API calls return predictable unauthorized responses
public pages do not expose private identifiers or fields
guest classroom access requires a valid public assignment contract
app does not enter redirect loop
no default privileged role is assumed
recovery is deterministic and idempotent
user receives an understandable next action
